tickets.title: The console's lift grid shows a stale slot (**amendment 3, 2026-10-17**)

authority.locator: P45 · section 2 of amendment 3; P42's closure line; the P42 delivery review section 11
authority.requirement: on the console's lift grid, a slot whose lift/rows answer carries `stale` is marked stale beside its numbers, naming the faulty page and slot and the last successful publish from the marker's members, and loses the mark when the answer no longer carries it; a slot without the marker renders byte for byte as today; the grid makes no new request; kit 02 states it, replacing its sentence that the grid does not show the marker.

tickets.outcome: An operator who works only in the console sees that a slot's lift numbers are stale, which page and slot are at fault and when the slot last published, instead of old numbers with no warning.

criteria.observable: On the console's lift grid, a slot whose lift/rows answer carries the `stale` marker is marked stale beside its numbers, naming the faulty page and slot and the last successful publish from the marker's members; when a later answer carries no marker the mark is gone.
criteria.proof: The P45 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P45.LG1 in src/units/P45 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A slot whose answer carries no marker renders byte for byte as today; the grid makes no request it does not make today; every P42 unit is unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P45 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P45.LG2 in src/units/P45 and they pass.

criteria.observable: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md states that the lift grid shows the stale marker (its sentence that the grid does not show it is gone) and docs/kit/03-payload-schemas.md is consistent.
criteria.proof: The P45 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P45.LG3 in src/units/P45 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The lift grid tells the operator a slot is stale, from the marker P42 already serves (the owner's rule, R-P78).
criteria.proof: Decision D1.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

remainingWork: Render: mark a stale slot on the lift grid from the marker's members, and clear the mark when it is gone.

tickets.title: A bootstrapped tenant's priors and proposals doors answer, not 503 (**amendment 3, 2026-10-17**)

authority.locator: P48 · section 2 of amendment 3; the live rehearsal (R-P79, lanes L1 to L4); the W08-C1 analysis
authority.requirement: a tenant bootstrapped through the demo door reads and publishes priors and proposals as an init-local tenant does; an already-bootstrapped four-member tenant has a named path to the same state; the priors and proposals reads of a tenant that still lacks them answer a refusal naming the missing member and the path, not a bare 503; the four supplied members and the door's existing refusals are unchanged; kit 02 states it.

tickets.outcome: An operator of a tenant bootstrapped through the demo door can read and publish priors and proposals like any other tenant, and if the tenant still lacks them the answer says which member is missing and how to add it, instead of a bare 503.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a tenant bootstrapped through the demo door reads and publishes priors and proposals as a tenant initialized with the six compiled defaults does (the specifier rules seeding the two compiled empties when the caller does not supply them, or a one-time repair under the same operator authority); the four supplied members and the door's existing refusals (the customer profile 404, the development-only 403, 409 on an existing head, the per-document validation) are unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P48 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P48.BP1 in src/units/P48 and they pass.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, an already-bootstrapped four-member tenant has a named path to the same state, and until it is taken its priors and proposals reads answer a refusal that names the missing member and the path, not a bare 503.
criteria.proof: The P48 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P48.BP2 in src/units/P48 and they pass.

criteria.observable: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md states the six-member outcome of the demo bootstrap and the path for an existing four-member tenant; the hosted seed (scripts/demo-kit/lib/host.mjs) takes that path.
criteria.proof: The P48 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P48.BP3 in src/units/P48 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A bootstrapped tenant is told why priors and proposals fail and is given the path, or never fails (the owner's rule, R-P78).
criteria.proof: Decision D1.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.

tickets.title: A learn republish does not leave a bare "statistics recovery required" (**amendment 3, 2026-10-17**)

authority.locator: P49 · section 2 of amendment 3; P42's reading (e); the live rehearsal
authority.requirement: on both hosts, after an authorized learn republish that changes a slot's accumulation tuple, the operator's publish answer and the lift reads either succeed or answer a refusal that names the republish as the cause (the slot, the member that changed, the old and new values) and says what ends it; the refusal of every other cause keeps its text; a republish that changes nothing in the tuple is not refused; kit 02 and 03 state it.

tickets.outcome: An operator who republishes the learn document with a changed reward or basis is told, on the publish answer and the lift reads, that the republish is the cause of the refusal and what ends it, instead of a bare 'statistics recovery required'.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, after an authorized learn republish that changes a slot's accumulation tuple, the operator's publish answer and the lift reads either succeed or answer a refusal that names the republish as the cause (the slot, the member that changed, the old and new values) and says what ends it (the generation transition, by whom or when).
criteria.proof: The P49 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P49.LR1 in src/units/P49 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A recovery refusal of every other cause keeps its text; a republish that changes nothing in the tuple is not refused; a slot not republished reads and publishes byte for byte as today; every P42 and P08 unit is unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P49 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P49.LR2 in src/units/P49 and they pass.

criteria.observable: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md and docs/kit/03-payload-schemas.md state the refusal's cause and what ends it.
criteria.proof: The P49 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P49.LR3 in src/units/P49 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The refusal after a learn republish names its cause and its end (the owner's rule, R-P78).
criteria.proof: Decision D1.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.
